methodology.inference: Static AST for Python; conservative @Test/@ParameterizedTest method scanner for every Scala test/src file; features and dependency edges are inferred from test bodies and tokens.
limitations: Python runtime-generated tests, doctests, parametrizations from imported/dynamic iterables, and helper behavior in other modules cannot always be expanded statically.
Scala scanner records @Test and @ParameterizedTest methods; generated tests, custom providers and non-JUnit frameworks may be missed.
Every Python test definition under test_*.py and every Scala JUnit-annotated method is represented, including outside_scope rows, to make scan coverage auditable.
Status is inventory state only. No upstream Hail test is marked passing based on similarity to Vail tests.
methodology.scala_coverage: All Scala .scala files under hail/test/src were scanned for @Test and @ParameterizedTest methods.
